sentences.text: Mr. Gaurav Singh vs Unknown on 19 June, 2023

Author: Sharad Kumar Sharma
Bench: Sharad Kumar Sharma
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders or
Sl. proceedings or
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  C482 No. 1174 of 2023  Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate, for the applicant.
Mr. Tumul Nainwal, Brief Holder, for the State of Uttarakhand.

In a pending Special Sessions Trial No. 9 of 2019, State Vs. Ashok Kumar Gadiya, where the applicant has been tried for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B and 511 of the IPC,
had filed an application, paper No. 169 Ka/1 on 17th May, 2023, praying for, that an appropriate direction may be issued, to consider his application for the renewal of the passport, which would be expiring on 4th July, 2023.

The said application is being sought to be directed to be decided in the light of the guidelines framed by the Notification issued by the Government of India in the notification issued by it, requiring for fulfilment of certain terms and conditions for renewal of the passport in those cases, where the criminal litigations are already going on.

Hence, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, this C482 Application would stand disposed of with the request to the Court of Special Sessions Judge, Dehradun, to consider the applicant's application, paper No.169 Ka/1, as expeditiously as possible, but in any manner before 4th July, 2023, and pass an appropriate order on the same in accordance with law.
Subject to the aforesaid, the C482 Applications stands disposed of.

(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) Dated 19.06.2023 Shiv Mr. Gaurav Singh vs Unknown on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82713030/
